Name: (RETIRED) Void's weird Wonders - Wallpapers and Floors for Alternative Textures
Author: VoidWitchCult
Description:
[center][img]https://i.postimg.cc/zD09S1Rm/title2-1-mod-details.png[/img]
﻿
[size=3][b][u]INFORMATION[/u]: [i]This mod still works in 1.6. It will not be updated further though.[/i][/b][/size]

Dabbled a bit into making some wallpapers and floors after having to convert some to Alternative Textures and thought it was fun to share the ones I made! It's mostly gothic-ish ones, some a bit more tacky than others maybe, haha!

Just install them as any other AT mod, you can change the wallpapers and floors while using the paintbucket that you can buy at Robin's shop. I just gave them numbers in-game but they technically got some names, I just thought they might be too long to use. If you care to know what names I give them here is a list(of the original set):

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/L65Gx0zJ/title2-1-installation.png[/img]
﻿
 - Install the latest version of SMAPI and Alternative Textures.
- Unzip the mod folder into Stardew Valley/Mods.
- Run the game using SMAPI.
